description: Engine-free Armenia v1 calibration authoring contracts. Observed quantities live only in the future ledger-am fact package. These series-level rows use the closed Ledger selector vocabulary and cover only count or deterministic indicator candidates. Chronicle must generate cell-level references and bindings from each harvested multi-cell table before runtime activation; identity resolution deliberately refuses an unexpanded table. Amount, income-diagnostic, and national-accounts validation facts are harvested outside this solver manifest.

target_references.name: armstat_population_by_age_sex_marz
target_references.notes: Primary age x sex x marz margin from the Statbank PxWeb endpoint. Chronicle must fan the harvested table into one dimension- and geography-pinned reference per selected cell; this row is not a scalar table total. The release profile projects the 2022-census-vintage series to 2024 in Ledger, and this package carries no level.

target_references.name: armstat_ilcs_households_by_size_marz
target_references.notes: Raw household structure derived from the public ILCS household file with official weights. Chronicle must generate a distinct direct/pre-built binding for every selected household-size x marz cell. Exact variable codes, bands, and current sample size are harvest items.

target_references.name: armstat_ilcs_households_by_consumption_band_marz
target_references.notes: Consumption is ArmStat's official welfare measure. Chronicle must replace the generic authoring filter with a reviewed pre-built indicator binding for every selected consumption-band x marz cell. A band is eligible only if it is scale-free with a matching authenticated donor indicator or uses an approved AMD-compatible pre-built bridge; raw US-dollar values may not be tested against AMD cutoffs. The bands describe raw consumption, not poverty classifications or survey-derived tax-benefit quantities.

target_references.name: armstat_lfs_employed_by_age_sex_marz
target_references.notes: Raw employment-status counts derived from the public 2024 LFS member microdata. Chronicle must generate dimension-pinned references and direct/pre-built bindings for selected age x sex x marz cells. Exact questionnaire codes and weighting fields are harvest items.

target_references.name: armstat_lfs_employees_by_industry_sex_marz
target_references.notes: Employee counts use direct labour-status and industry columns. Chronicle must generate dimension-pinned references and direct/pre-built bindings for selected industry x sex x marz cells; no Armenian tax or benefit engine output is involved.

target_references.name: armstat_src_payroll_employees_by_industry_sex_marz
target_references.notes: Administrative payroll-employee counts from the SRC-register series published by ArmStat. Chronicle must identify the exact one of nine published datasets, then generate selected industry x sex x marz cell references and bindings.

target_references.name: armstat_pensioner_caseload
target_references.notes: Harvest a current 2024 caseload and pin its exact fact identity. The supplied January 2022 count is stale evidence only and must not silently populate this reference.

target_references.name: armstat_family_social_benefit_families
target_references.notes: Harvest and pin the current ArmStat caseload for families receiving family and social benefits. Benefit-rule amounts and eligibility are not used in engine-free v1.
